groups.basis: Same name as the first-round list 'Vivre mieux La gauche unie, écologiste, citoyenne et solidaire' (nuance LUG); merged second-round list LDVG.

method: Outcome from 'type_vote'. The 'vote' field lists, under 'Contre', 'Abstention' and 'Ne participe pas au vote', the groups (or individual councillors) concerned; votes in favour are not listed. byGroup therefore marks a group 'for' with implied=true when it is not listed and a vote took place. 'except' = members of the group who did not follow it (named in the source). Individual councillors named outside a group are in 'individuals'. Unanimous votes: every group 'for' (implied).
